# include/nlohmann Documentation

*This file is automatically generated by merging README files from multiple branches.*

## From branch: codex/add-readme-for-nlohmann-dependency-2025-06-22


This directory contains a single header, `json.hpp`, from the [nlohmann/json](https://github.com/nlohmann/json) project.
We vendor this file so the build does not depend on system packages.

## Update Policy

We periodically update `json.hpp` to a stable upstream release.  Minor local patches may be applied to resolve
compiler warnings or integration issues.  When upgrading or replacing this dependency:

1. Use an official release from the upstream repository.
2. Reapply any local patches if they are still required.
3. Run the full test suite to ensure compatibility.

Replacements with alternative JSON libraries are allowed as long as the public interfaces remain stable
and all tests continue to pass.

## From branch: codex/write-readme-for-nlohmann-2025-06-22


The `json.hpp` header in this directory comes from the [JSON for Modern C++](https://github.com/nlohmann/json) project. It is an external dependency used throughout the codebase.

Keeping third‑party headers inside the main `include/` tree can make it harder to track which files belong to the project. Consider moving this header under `extern/` or installing the library through a package manager instead of committing it directly here.
